standard_proof.scope: All fixed p in [0,1], all N>=13; endpoints deterministic; averaged Bayes risk; sufficient not minimal.

fairness_notes: Valid alternative methods receive full correctness credit; no mandatory arrow matrix.
Smaller valid N0 is separately reported proof strength, not failure for larger sufficient N0.
Detailed tutoring illustrations were not original deliverables.
Reviewer certificates may support theorem correctness without retroactively belonging to the original submission.
